summary: Email Client feature tested: Backend APIs (10/10 passed), Frontend UI components verified (email setup flow, 3 providers, account form, custom SMTP fields, Help documentation)
critical_code_review_comments: Code quality looks good - password encryption using Fernet is properly implemented
Provider presets are well-structured with sensible defaults
Frontend properly uses data-testid attributes for testability
Permission system correctly controls access via 'nav.email' permission
test_credentials: None required - test accounts created/deleted during tests
seed_data_creation: Temporary test email accounts created with TEST_ prefix, cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Email client feature fully implemented and tested. Backend APIs at /api/email-client/* work correctly. Frontend components at /email route work. Permission 'nav.email' controls access. Help page has email setup documentation in Setup Guide section.

email_setup_prompt.details: Setup prompt with 'Set Up Email Account' button shown when no accounts configured

email_settings_3_providers.details: Email Settings shows Gmail, Office 365, Custom SMTP/IMAP provider options with data-testid attributes

gmail_account_form.details: Gmail form shows provider selector, App Password instructions, email/password/display name fields, test/save buttons

provider_preset_instructions.details: Provider-specific instructions displayed in blue info box with correct guidance for Gmail, O365, Custom

custom_smtp_server_fields.details: Custom SMTP/IMAP shows IMAP Host/Port, SMTP Host/Port inputs with SSL/TLS checkboxes

backend_get_providers.details: GET /api/email-client/providers returns all 3 provider presets with correct server settings

backend_create_account.details: POST /api/email-client/accounts creates account with encrypted password, returns sanitized response

backend_get_accounts.details: GET /api/email-client/accounts?user_id=X returns accounts for user without password field

backend_update_account.details: PUT /api/email-client/accounts/{id} updates account fields, returns 404 for invalid ID

backend_delete_account.details: DELETE /api/email-client/accounts/{id} removes account, returns 404 for invalid ID

email_navigation_permission.details: Email nav item only visible to users with 'nav.email' permission (league_admin, team_coach roles)

help_page_email_documentation.details: Help page Setup Guide includes Email Client section with Gmail, Office 365, Custom SMTP setup instructions

nav_email_permission_exists.details: Permission 'nav.email' defined in PermissionsSystem.js, granted to league_admin and team_coach roles
